-- in --
package main

templ test(x bool) {
	<span>This span holds text long enough that its group has to break into lines, and it ends with a space </span>
	<div>
		text before a comment <!-- c --> and after it
		trailing space then newline 
		<b>bold</b>
	</div>
	<p>
		trailing space before a Go comment 
		// c
	</p>
}
-- out --
package main

templ test(x bool) {
	<span>
		This span holds text long enough that its group has to break into lines, and it ends with a
		space </span>
	<div>
		text before a comment <!-- c --> and after it trailing space then newline  <b>bold</b>
	</div>
	<p>
		trailing space before a Go comment 
		// c
	</p>
}
